cues.en: contrary, you'll find that they're quite stationary.
cues.zh: 相反，你会发现他们相当静止。

cues.en: All of my action figures and cherry. Stephen Hawking's in my library. My Myspace page, all totally pissed out. Got people begging for my top eight spaces. Yo, I know pie to a thousand places. Ain't got no grills, I still wear braces. I order all of my sandwiches for mayonnaise.
cues.zh: 我所有的可动人偶和樱桃。斯蒂芬·霍金在我的书房里。我的Myspace页面，全都气疯了。有人求我给他们前八个位置。哟，我知道圆周率到一千位。没戴牙套，我还戴着矫正器。我点三明治全要蛋黄酱。

cues.en: Having a sale down at the Gap. Spent my nights with a roll of bubble wrap. Pop pop. Hope no one sees me. Getting freaky. I'm nerdy, indie, extreme, and whiter than sour cream. I was in a b club and glee club and even the chess team. Only question I ever thought hard, what do I like her or do I like Picard? Spent every weekend at the Renaissance Fair, got my name on my underwear. They see me strolling.
cues.zh: Gap店在打折。我晚上抱着一卷泡泡纸过。啪、啪。希望没人看见我。玩得疯。我是书呆子、独立范、极端，还比酸奶油更白。我参加过b俱乐部、欢乐合唱团，甚至国际象棋队。我唯一认真想过的问题是，我喜欢她还是喜欢Picard？每个周末都去文艺复兴集市，内裤上印着我的名字。他们看见我闲逛。

cues.en: and rolling their eyes because I'm so white and nerdy. Just because I'm
cues.zh: 还翻着白眼，因为我太白人、太书呆子气了。就因为我是
